create_CPUOnlyParameter: create a CPUOnlyParameter torch.nn.Parameter that stays on CPU even during cuda calls
use_VectorNormalizer: use the VectorNormalizer class to normalize feature vectors for torchscript models
use_BPE_tokenizer: use the BPE tokenizer to encode text into subword token sequences
use_Vocabulary: use the Vocabulary class to map tokens to integer indices for model input
use_torchscript_utils: use torchscript utility functions like pad_2d_mask and make_sequence_lengths for tensor preprocessing
